remarks: Enjoy privacy in a prime location with this recently updated unit that offers both comfort and flexibility. The remodeled kitchen features stainless steel appliances, quarts countertops, brand-new cabinetry, and new LVP flooring for both style and function. Hardwood flooring runs throughout main living spaces and bedrooms. Main level includes a spacious living room along with an extra room that can easily be used as an office or 3rd bedroom. Upstairs, find 2 bedrooms and a beautifully renovated full bathroom. Parking is a breeze with one garage space plus 2 additional off-street parking spaces in the driveway. Washer and dryer hook-up available in utility room behind garage. Located close to all amenities greenwich has to offer, public transportation, schools, parks, parkways and I-95.
